validation_method: Every lot car with a rule WMI, a 17-character VIN and a valid check digit is classified. The model year comes from VIN character 10 (the listing year only picks the 30-year cycle and must be within 2 years). A rule fires only when the VIN matches its WMI, years and fixed characters and its code (series characters, or the engine character for engine rules) has a transmission in that YEAR's table; codes whose description names no transmission give no claim, and the next rule in scope is tried. Ground truth = scraper/manual_detect/ground_truth.jsonl; uniformCell lines are unlabelled, speeds-only lines are excluded, the rest are checkable: agree means (truth is manual) == (rule says manual). GM's VIN ground truth is vPIC, which is built from these same filings (partly circular): it checks that the right year table was read, not the filing itself. Independent checks: EPA rows per engine/sub-model rule (every rule year must have rows and all must be the claimed class), and a per-car EPA union check (year, make, feed/vPIC model, vPIC displacement). Status: candidate (not counted) when flagged or when the EPA sole-offering check fails; drop when >= 20 checkable and agreement < 0.995; low_sample when < 20 checkable; keep otherwise. newly_confirmed_manual counts lot cars with no published transmission (vehicle_extras trans empty) that a keep or low_sample rule calls manual.

This is partly circular (vPIC is built from GM's filings): it proves the year tables were parsed the way vPIC reads them, not that GM's filing is right. No VIN-bearing listing-text car falls in scope, so there is no independent per-car ground truth. Feed make/model matches the VIN's decoded line for every in-scope car.

Z2 'FWD Manual' / Z3 'FWD Auto' (WMI 5GZ, positions 5-6) read in every 5GZ table from the first one: 8063 (Dec 2000), 8100 (Feb 2001), 8753 and 8940 (Jul 2001), 8755 (Oct 2001), 9012/9013 (May 2002), 9063/9064 (Jun 2002), 9606 (Apr 2003), 9604/9605 (Jul 2003), 9926 OCR (Jan 2004), 11174 OCR and the MY2007 page C8 image (Dec 2005: 'Z 2 Vue FWD Manual, Z 3 Vue FWD Auto'). Z2 never meant anything else, so the 6 MY2002 Z2 cars (scraper's uniform-cell drop) are manual by GM's definition in force for the whole model year.

Independent: EPA 2002 Vue FWD 2.2 lists 'Manual 5-spd' and 'Automatic (variable gear ratios)'; NRCan 2002-2007 Vue 2.2 lists M5 plus AV (2002-2005) or A4 (2005-2007), so a FWD 4-cylinder manual existed every rule year. MY2007 Z3 includes the Green Line hybrid (engine Z), which NRCan lists as A4 only, so the automatic claim holds.

Lot pattern fits code-per-transmission: in the CVT years Z2 outnumbers Z3 (2004: 22 vs 7, 2002: 6 vs 0, consistent with CVT cars leaving the fleet early), in the 4-speed-automatic years Z3 dominates (2006: 7 vs 35, 2007: 7 vs 46).

hub_findings.finding: vPIC decodes MY2008 Cobalt / G5 with GM's superseded April-2007 table
hub_findings.evidence: The April 2007 MY2008 issue (ORG3532) split Cobalt and G5 series by transmission; GM's May 2008 4th revision (ORG21681) replaced it with plain trims (Cobalt AJ Base, AK 1LS, AL 1LT, AM Sport, AP SS; G5 AJ base, AL SE, AN GT) and every lot 2008 Cobalt/G5 carries only those codes (no AN/AR/AT/AW/AU Cobalts at all, which the April table would need for every manual). vPIC nevertheless returns the April meanings: 2008 Cobalt AK 'Automatic', AL/AM 'Automated Manual (AMT)', G5 AL 'Automatic' and G5 AN 'Manual' (GT). The G5 GT had both transmissions, so the 'Manual' badge on 2008 G5 AN cars is not evidence about those cars.
hub_findings.suggested_action: Hub decision (scraper change, not made here): add MY2008 Cobalt and G5 (and, for consistency, vPIC 'AMT' on 2008 Cobalts) to VPIC_TRANS_DEFAULT_CELLS-style drops so the 2008 G5 AN cars lose the Manual badge.

hub_findings.finding: Two of the scraper's dropped 'uniform manual' cells are true manuals per GM's filings
hub_findings.evidence: 2002 Saturn VUE series 2 is 'FWD Manual' in every MY2002-2007 GM filing (C3g), and 2002 Saturn SL (ZF) is 'SL Manual' in the latest MY2002 issue (01-022-N11B-9012). The 2001 SL (ZF = 'SL' in MY2001) and the 2007 HHR (series = trim) are not confirmed. The series rules here relabel the 2002 VUE and 2002 SL cars as manual from the VIN itself (counted in newly_confirmed_manual).
hub_findings.suggested_action: Integration: apply saturn_vue_series_2002_2007 (and the ZS code of saturn_s_l_series_2000_2003) ahead of VPIC_TRANS_DEFAULT_CELLS; keep the drops for 2001 SL, 2002 SL ZF and 2007 HHR.
hub_findings.verification_note: Corrected 2026-11-05: only the 2002 VUE (series Z2) cars are shown to be true manuals. 2002 SL series ZF is NOT confirmed: the Oct-2001 MY2002 issue (01-022-N11B-8755, page B7) reads plain 'SL' with no ZL code, and 'SL Manual' / 'ZL SL Auto' appear only in the Apr-2002 issue from an undated revision missing from MID. Keep the scraper's drops for 2001 SL, 2002 SL (ZF) and 2007 HHR; apply saturn_vue_series_2002_2007 ahead of VPIC_TRANS_DEFAULT_CELLS. 2002 SL ZS (Spring Special) is new in the Apr-2002 issue and stays manual.
